content.text:
Found 3 blocking issues in PR 1271:

- [P1] `frontend/src/app/backend.service.ts:31` — `adminLogin()` delegates to `login()`, sending unprotected admin logins to `/session/login`. If admin PoW is disabled, admin login is broken because backend treats credentials as a Login, not User/admin.

- [P1] `backend/src/controller/SessionController.class.php:66` — rejected admin requests include the submitted password in the error message. This can expose passwords through responses and server/client logging. Never interpolate credentials.

- [P1] `backend/src/controller/SessionController.class.php:82` — PoW is skipped when password/code is empty. Passwordless Login and Person flows therefore retain no brute-force protection, despite being supported authentication paths. Existing throttling/delay was also removed, leaving username/code enumeration unrestricted.

Additional concern: solved challenges have no apparent expiry or replay prevention, so the same signed solution can create sessions repeatedly.

PR is also currently conflicting with `master`; no CI checks are reported.
